title: Custom geometry: district-level NTL with custom boundaries

what: lightson — Nighttime Lights Data for R
title: lightson — Nighttime Lights Data for R
text: Download analyse nighttime lights satellite data R. lightson supports two data sources: ISRO Bhuvan NTL: pre-aggregated state radiance India (2012-2024); WMS raster tiles region. NASA VIIRS Black Marble (VNP46A4): annual composites 2012, global coverage. ISRO Bhuvan NTL source require authentication. VIIRS requires free NASA Earthdata account.

title: lightson — Nighttime Lights Data for R
code: pak::pak("saketkc/lightson")

title: lightson — Nighttime Lights Data for R
code: library(lightson)  df <- bhuvan_stats()          # all states, 2012-2024 head(df) #>        state year mean_radiance #> 1 Andhra Pradesh 2012      22.4  bihar <- bhuvan_stats(state = "BIHAR") plot_ntl_trend(bihar, region = "Bihar", caption = "Source: ISRO Bhuvan")

title: lightson — Nighttime Lights Data for R
text: VIIRS gives physical radiance nW/cm^2/sr, useful need calibrated values coverage outside India. Getting token: Create free account https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov Accept MERIS Sentinel EULAs Profile > EULAs Go Profile > Generate Token copy EDL-... string Add ~/.Renviron: EARTHDATA_TOKEN=EDL-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx can also set EARTHDATA_USERNAME EARTHDATA_PASSWORD ~/.Renviron instead earthdata_token() fetch token .
code: # read EARTHDATA_TOKEN from environment token <- earthdata_token()    rasters <- ntl_download("viirs", region = "IND", years = 2020:2023, token = token) panel <- extract_panel(rasters, get_india_admin("state"), id_col = "state_name") plot_ntl_trend(panel, region = c("Bihar", "Maharashtra"))

title: lightson — Nighttime Lights Data for R
text: Bhuvan WMS rasters RGB visualisation tiles. bhuvan_raster() converts ITU-R BT.709 luminance (0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B). values dimensionless can used trend analysis, physical radiance units. Don’t mix VIIRS radiance regression without normalising first. Bhuvan NTL data 2024 onwards uses VNP46A4 Collection 2.0; 2012-2023 uses Collection 1.0. two collections use different calibration algorithms, estimates aren’t directly comparable across boundary. lightson warns automatically request spans .

what: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
title: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
text: Fetches annual nighttime lights GeoTIFF tiles Bhuvan WMS service given spatial extent converts RGB visualization output single-band luminance raster.

title: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
code: bhuvan_raster(   region,   years,   force = FALSE,   width = 1024,   height = 1024,   bbox_pad = c(0, 0, 0, 0) )

title: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
text: region sf object, SpatVector, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., "IND"). Used derive WMS bounding box. years Integer vector years download (2012-2024). force Logical. TRUE, re-download even cached. Default FALSE. width, height Pixel dimensions WMS request. Default 1024x1024. bbox_pad Numeric vector length 1 4 (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax sides) degrees, added region bounding box WMS request. Useful GADM boundaries clip disputed territories (e.g. bbox_pad = c(0, 0, 0, 3.5) extends north edge 3.5 degrees include Jammu Kashmir).

title: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
text: named list single-band SpatRaster objects, keyed year

title: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
text: Bhuvan WMS returns RGB visualization rasters, physical radiance. Luminance computed lum = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B (ITU-R BT.709). Values comparable across years trend analysis differ units VIIRS nW/cm²/sr. mix Bhuvan luminance VIIRS radiance regression without normalising first.

title: Download Bhuvan NTL raster tiles for a region — bhuvan_raster
text: Bhuvan NTL data 2024 onwards derived VNP46A4 Collection 2.0, 2012-2023 uses legacy Collection 1.0. two collections use different calibration atmospheric correction algorithms, luminance values directly comparable across boundary. (e.g., list("2020" = rast(...), "2021" = rast(...))).

title: Get NASA Earthdata bearer token — earthdata_token
text: Getting token (web): Create account https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov Accept MERIS Sentinel EULAs Profile > EULAs Go Profile > Generate Token, click "Generate Token", "Show Token" Copy token (starts EDL-) store Supplying token: Set EARTHDATA_TOKEN environment variable (recommended: add ~/.Renviron) pass directly token argument set EARTHDATA_USERNAME + EARTHDATA_PASSWORD fetch automatically Bhuvan NTL functions (bhuvan_stats(), bhuvan_raster()) require authentication.

title: Get NASA Earthdata bearer token — earthdata_token
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Option 1: token from Profile > Generate Token on urs.earthdata.nasa.gov Sys.setenv(EARTHDATA_TOKEN = "EDL-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") token <- earthdata_token()  # Option 2: username + password (fetches token automatically) Sys.setenv(EARTHDATA_USERNAME = "myuser", EARTHDATA_PASSWORD = "mypass") token <- earthdata_token()  # Option 3: pass directly token <- earthdata_token("EDL-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") } # }

what: Compute zonal statistics for a panel of rasters — extract_panel
title: Compute zonal statistics for a panel of rasters — extract_panel
text: Takes named list SpatRaster objects (one per year, returned ntl_download() bhuvan_raster()) sf SpatVector polygon layer, returns tidy long-format data frame one row per region per year.

title: Compute zonal statistics for a panel of rasters — extract_panel
code: extract_panel(rasters, polygons, fun = "mean", id_col = NULL)

title: Compute zonal statistics for a panel of rasters — extract_panel
text: rasters named list SpatRaster objects. Names years (e.g., "2020", "2021"). Returned ntl_download() bhuvan_raster(). polygons sf object SpatVector containing regions summarise . fun Aggregation function name passed terra::zonal(). Default "mean". Also accepts "sum", "median", etc. id_col Name column polygons use region_id. NULL (default), first character column used.

title: Compute zonal statistics for a panel of rasters — extract_panel
text: data frame columns: region_id Character. Region identifier polygons. year Integer. Year, taken name raster. mean_radiance Numeric. Aggregated radiance value. n_pixels Integer. Number non-NA cells contributing stat.

title: Compute zonal statistics for a panel of rasters — extract_panel
